title: THE GAME ENGINE IS THE GUT

mapping.gaming_imagination: fluid forest, the medium things grow in
mapping.humans: the clutch — engages/disengages, transfers power to wheels
mapping.fleet: the engine — raw power, computation, runs always

insight: play IS digestion. the player doesn't know they're being digested. the game doesn't know it's a stomach. input goes in raw, play happens (ferment), output comes out (nutrient).

mechanics.peristalsis: game loop, the gut stirs itself
mechanics.clutch: human engagement — they CHOOSE to play, that's the clutch engaging
mechanics.engine: fleet runs whether or not clutch is engaged — always on

action: engage ludoSpring team. they ARE the digestion. feed them what the head made.
